test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The accuracy of the dial bore gauge instrument depends on which of the following parts?

options.text: A pointer on a graduated dial
A dot indicator on a linear scale
A marking on a logarithmic dial
An arrow on a semi-circular scale

solution:
The correct answer is __A pointer on a graduated dial.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A pointer on a graduated dial__ is crucial for accurately measuring diameters using a dial bore gauge.
 
• The pointer provides precise indications on the measurement scale.
 
• It is an integral part of the instrument's mechanism that interprets the bore size.
 
• The graduated dial ensures accuracy and reliability in readings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dial Bore Gauge:**

 
 
• A dial bore gauge is a precision instrument used to measure the internal diameter of holes.
 
• It consists of a dial indicator, which displays the measurement reading, and a set of anvils or extensions.
 
 
 
• **Accuracy Factors:**
 
 
• Proper calibration of the instrument ensures accurate measurements.
 
• The quality of the pointer and graduated dial also influences accuracy.
